	WWPBaseObjects.LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated OrdenEtiquetadoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"OrdenEtiquetadoId"
					&Insert_OrdenEtiquetadoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated PalletEtiquetadoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"PalletEtiquetadoId"
					&Insert_PalletEtiquetadoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated CarreteEtiquetadoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"CarreteEtiquetadoId"
					&Insert_CarreteEtiquetadoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
